answer: A sybil operator reuses one mind behind many masks, so force divergent judgment: each identity is privately assigned a unique set of anonymized relic transcripts seeded with subtle contradictions, and must flag them within a short window. Honest agents err idiosyncratically; clones sharing prompts, heuristics and velvet-smooth templates err identically on the same traps, exposing correlation. Each added identity draws a fresh, non-transferable trap set from a public-random dune of cases, so work cannot be pooled or precomputed and scaling multiplies exposure.
